```{r}

draw_cm <- function(subset_name){
  df <- df%>%
  filter(split == subset_name)
  
  
  cm <- confusionMatrix(
  factor(df$pred, levels = c(0, 1)),
  factor(df$flow, levels = c(0, 1)),
  positive = "1"
  )
  print(cm)  
  
  confusion_table <- table(Actual = df$flow, Predicted = df$pred)

  # Convert to data frame and add proper labels
  confusion_matrix <- data.frame(
    Actual = c("Diploid", "Aneuploid"),  # 0 = Diploid, 1 = Aneuploid
    Diploid = c(confusion_table[1,1], confusion_table[2,1]),    # Predicted as 0
    Aneuploid = c(confusion_table[1,2], confusion_table[2,2])   # Predicted as 1
  )
  
  # Calculate the total for each actual class
  confusion_matrix$Total <- rowSums(confusion_matrix[, -1])
  
  # Calculate percentages
  confusion_matrix_percent <- confusion_matrix
  confusion_matrix_percent[, 2:3] <- confusion_matrix[, 2:3] / confusion_matrix$Total * 100
  
  # Melt the data frame for percentages
  confusion_matrix_melted_percent <- melt(select(confusion_matrix_percent, -Total),
                                          id.vars = "Actual",
                                          variable.name = "Predicted",
                                          value.name = "Percentage")
  
  # Melt the data frame for absolute numbers
  confusion_matrix_melted_abs <- melt(select(confusion_matrix, -Total),
                                      id.vars = "Actual",
                                      variable.name = "Predicted",
                                      value.name = "Count")
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = confusion_matrix_melted_percent,
              aes(y = Actual, x = Predicted, fill = Percentage)) +
    geom_text(data = confusion_matrix_melted_percent,
              aes(y = Actual, x = Predicted, label = paste0(round(Percentage, 1), "%")),
              color = "black", size = 5.5, vjust = -0.5) +
    geom_text(data = confusion_matrix_melted_abs,
              aes(y = Actual, x = Predicted, label = Count),
              color = "black", size = 4.5, vjust = 1.5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkgreen", limits = c(0, 100)) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +  
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +  
    labs(x = "Predicted", y = "Actual", title = paste0(R.utils::capitalize(subset_name), " set") ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
          title = element_text(size = 25))
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
roc_list <- prebs %>%
  group_split(subset) %>%
  map(~ {
    roc_obj <- roc(.x$flow, .x$p_1, quiet = TRUE)
    data.frame(
      specificity = rev(roc_obj$specificities),
      sensitivity = rev(roc_obj$sensitivities),
      subset = unique(.x$subset)
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Calculate AUC values for each subset
auc_labels <- prebs %>%
  group_split(subset) %>%
  map_df(~ {
    roc_obj <- roc(.x$flow, .x$p_1, quiet = TRUE)
    data.frame(subset = unique(.x$subset), auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)))
  })

# Plot with ggplot2
roc_plot <- ggplot(roc_list, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, color = subset)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  labs(
    x = "1 - Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
    y = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)"
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",  # Remove the legend
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),  # Increase axis title text size
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12)     # Increase axis text size
  )

# Add AUC annotations to the plot
for (i in seq_along(auc_labels$subset)) {
  roc_plot <- roc_plot +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0.6,
      y = 0.4 - 0.1 * i,
      label = paste(auc_labels$subset[i], "set AUC:", round(auc_labels$auc[i], 3)),
      color = "black",
      size = 6
    )
}

# Print the plot
print(roc_plot)

ggsave(paste0(save_folder,"/1.mil/aneuploid_roc.pdf"), roc_plot, width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 300, units = "cm")
```

```{r flow_mil combined }
plot_contingency <- function(tmp_df, dataset_value, var){
  
  var_sym <- sym(var)
  print(dataset_value)
  if(dataset_value != "whole"){
    tmp_df <- tmp_df %>%
      filter(dataset == dataset_value)
  }
  print(nrow(tmp_df))
  
  # Debug: Check what data we have
  cat("Factor levels:", levels(tmp_df$progression), "\n")
  cat("Unique values:", unique(as.character(tmp_df$progression)), "\n")
  
  # Calculate p-value
  pval <- table(tmp_df[c(var, 'progression')]) %>%
    chisq.test() %>%
    .$p.value
  
  # Get number of unique levels for annotation positioning
  n_levels <- length(unique(tmp_df[[var]]))
  x_pos <- (n_levels + 1) / 2
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- tmp_df %>%
    group_by(!!var_sym, progression) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = !!var_sym, y = prop, fill = progression)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") + 
      geom_text(aes(label = count),
                position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), 
                size = 2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ca0020", "#92c5de")) +
      labs(x = tools::toTitleCase(var), y = "Proportion (%)") +
      annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = 1.05, 
               label = bquote(chi^2 ~ ", p=" ~ .(signif(pval, 3))), size = 1.6) +
      theme_light() + 
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 5),
            axis.text = element_text(size = 4),
            legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 4))
  
  # ggsave(file.path(save_folder, paste0("co_",dataset,"_", var, ".pdf")), p, height = 3.7, width = 6, units = "cm")
  print(p)
}
```

```{r disp}

plot_contingency <- function(tmp_df, var_x, var_y){
  save_folder = "/Volumes/rsrch5/home/trans_mol_path/cercan/BE_master/4.plotting/output/0.input"
  var_x_sym <- sym(var_x)
  var_y_sym <- sym(var_y)
  
  # Calculate p-value
  pval <- table(tmp_df[c(var_x, var_y)]) %>%
    chisq.test() %>%
    .$p.value
  
  # Get number of unique levels for annotation positioning
  n_levels <- length(unique(tmp_df[[var_x]]))
  x_pos <- (n_levels) / 2  # Center the annotation
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- tmp_df %>%
    group_by(!!var_x_sym, !!var_y_sym) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = !!var_x_sym, y = prop, fill = !!var_y_sym)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") + 
      geom_text(aes(label = count),
                position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), 
                size = 2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ca0020", "#92c5de")) +
      labs(x = tools::toTitleCase(var_x), y = "Proportion (%)") +  # Dynamic x-label
      annotate("text", x = x_pos, y = 1.05, 
               label = bquote(chi^2 ~ ", p=" ~ .(signif(pval, 3))), size = 1.6) +
      theme_light() + 
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5),
            axis.title = element_text(size = 5),      # Increase axis title size
            axis.text = element_text(size = 4),       # Increase axis text size
            legend.title = element_text(size = 5),    # Control legend title size
            legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
            legend.position = "none")
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(file.path(save_folder, paste0("dysplasia_", var_x, ".pdf")), p, height = 3.5, width = 3.5, units = "cm")
  print(p)
  # Return the plot object
  
}

tmp_df <- df %>%
  mutate(Slide = as.numeric(substr(Slide, nchar(Slide), nchar(Slide))))%>%
  drop_na(GradeOfDysplasia,pred)%>%
  group_by(wsi,pred,patient,fu_time,flow,Dataset,split)%>%
  summarise(GradeOfDysplasia = first(GradeOfDysplasia[Slide == max(Slide)]), .groups = 'drop')%>%
  mutate(flow = as.numeric(flow))%>%
  mutate(dysplasia = case_when(
    GradeOfDysplasia %in% c("LGD","LGD/HGD", "HGD/LGD", "HGD") ~ "Dysplasia",
    GradeOfDysplasia == "N" ~ "No Dysplasia"))

plot_contingency(tmp_df, "flow", "dysplasia")
plot_contingency(tmp_df, "pred", "dysplasia")
```
